# Plotscaper

Plotscaper is an R package designed for making interactive figures for
data exploration. All plots in `plotscaper` support linked selection by
default, as well as wide variety of other interactions, including,
zooming, panning, reordering, and parameter manipulation.

The package powering `plotscaper` figures
([plotscape](https://github.com/bartonicek/plotscape)) is written in
(mostly) vanilla TypeScript/JavaScript and uses no external
dependencies/framework for reactivity.

## Quick start

To get started, install `plotscaper`, either from CRAN (by running
`install.packages("plotscaper")`), or, if you want the latest
development version, run the following:

``` r
devtools::install_github("bartonicek/plotscaper")
```

Next, open up RStudio and run the following code:

``` r
library(plotscaper)

names(airquality) <- c("ozone", "solar radiation", "wind", 
                       "temperature", "month", "day")

create_schema(airquality) |>
  add_scatterplot(c("solar radiation", "ozone")) |>
  add_barplot(c("day", "ozone"), list(reducer = "max")) |>
  add_histogram(c("wind")) |>
  add_pcoords(names(airquality)[1:4]) |>
  render()
#> Warning in create_schema(airquality): Removed 42 rows with missing values from
#> the data
#> file:////tmp/Rtmp4tjfwm/file2ed9666bcd3cc/widget2ed9652d3ad32.html screenshot completed
```

![](reference/figures/readme1.pngunnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

In your viewer, you should now see something like the (static) image
above, however, your version should be fully interactive. Try clicking
and dragging the scatterplot to select a few points!

Alternatively, to see a fully interactive version of the figure online,
go to one of the vignettes such as [Get
started](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/articles/plotscaper.md).

(the image above is just a static snapshot because Github doesn’t allow
JavaScript in `README.md`. The other vignettes are full HTML files
rendered with RMarkdown and do support JavaScript as a result)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_barplot()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/add_barplot.md)
  : Add a barplot to a scene or schema

- [`add_bibarplot()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/add_bibarplot.md)
  : Add a mirrored barplot to a scene or schema

- [`add_fluctplot()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/add_fluctplot.md)
  : Add a fluctuation diagram to a scene or schema

- [`add_histogram()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/add_histogram.md)
  : Add a histogram to a scene or schema

- [`add_histogram2d()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/add_histogram2d.md)
  : Add a 2D histogram to a scene or schema

- [`add_pcoords()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/add_pcoords.md)
  : Add a parallel coordinates plot to a scene or schema

- [`add_plot()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/add_plot.md)
  : Add a plot to a scene or schema

- [`add_scatterplot()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/add_scatterplot.md)
  : Add a scatterplot to a scene or schema

- [`assign_cases()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/assign_cases.md)
  : Assign cases to a group

- [`assigned_cases()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/assigned_cases.md)
  : Get assigned cases

- [`clear_layout()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/clear_layout.md)
  : Set interactive scene layout

- [`create_schema()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/create_schema.md)
  :

  Create a `plotscaper` schema

- [`dispatch_message()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/dispatch_message.md)
  : Dispatches a message to a plotscaper scene or schema

- [`get_plot_ids()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/get_plot_ids.md)
  : Return a list of plot ids from a plotscaper scene or schema

- [`get_scale()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/get_scale.md)
  : Get a plot scale

- [`id`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/id.md) : Plot
  id

- [`normalize()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/normalize.md)
  : Normalize a plot

- [`plotscaperOutput()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/plotscaper-shiny.md)
  [`renderPlotscaper()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/plotscaper-shiny.md)
  : Shiny bindings for plotscaper

- [`plotscaper_global`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/plotscaper_global.md)
  : A Plotscaper Global Configuration Object

- [`pop_plot()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/pop_plot.md)
  : Remove the last plot from a scene or schema

- [`reducer()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/reducer.md)
  : Create a reducer

- [`remove_plot()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/remove_plot.md)
  : Remove specific plot from a scene or schema

- [`render()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/render.md)
  : Render a schema into an interactive scene

- [`reset()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/reset.md)
  : Reset a scene or schema

- [`select_cases()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/select_cases.md)
  : Select cases of the data

- [`selected_cases()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/selected_cases.md)
  : Get selected cases

- [`set_layout()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/set_layout.md)
  : Set interactive scene layout

- [`set_parameters()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/set_parameters.md)
  : Set reactive parameters

- [`set_scale()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/set_scale.md)
  : Set values of a scale

- [`start_server()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/start_server.md)
  :

  Start a server for communication between the R session and
  `plostcaper` scenes

- [`zoom()`](https://bartonicek.github.io/plotscaper/reference/zoom.md)
  : Zoom into an area of a plot
